owner: OPT-NC (Office des Postes et Télécommunications de Nouvelle-Calédonie; CITIUS subsidiary)
notes: Operational OPT-NC server/data facility at DC Nouville, 1 Rue Contre-Amiral Joseph du Bouzet, Nouville (Nouméa, Province Sud), historically operated by CITIUS (OPT-NC subsidiary since 2008). OPT-NC official release (2023-10-18) states the DC Nouville site hosts the data center, accounts for ~4.5% of OPT-NC electricity consumption, and received 276 solar panels (124 kWp); DCD independently reported the same operational site. No IT load or MW capacity disclosed.
